data.exact_reserve_text: The result for Syndicate 1492 for the year ended 31 December 2017 is a loss of GBP 27,821,000 (2016: GBP 12,376,000 loss), of which a loss of GBP 26,780,000 is attributable to the 2017 year of account, a loss of GBP 1,898,000 is attributable to the 2016 year of account and a profit of GBP 857,000 is attributable to the 2015 year of account.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 2.134 million, primarily driven by favourable development on the 2015 underwriting year as calculated from the gross claims development triangle. No specific causes for this movement were detailed in the report. The Directors' Report also noted a net loss of GBP 1.898 million for the 2016 year of account and a net profit of GBP 0.857 million for the 2015 year of account, indicating mixed development across prior years on a net basis.

data.data_quality_notes: Discrepancy in 2015 year of account result: Active Underwriter's Report states a loss of GBP 3.6m, while Directors' Report states a profit of GBP 0.857m. Directors' Report figure used for year-of-account breakdown. Prior year development amount is calculated from the gross claims development triangle for the 2015 underwriting year, as per instructions to use gross figures and exclude the two most recent underwriting years. The year-of-account breakdown on page 2 is a net figure.
